description: Freehand fallback after insert_* feature tools. part_id is required and must be the active part's opaque surf id (a vault path or display name is unknown_part; another id is part_mismatch). Writes that part, runs it, and records one undo step when the text changes. Working copy only: nothing reaches git without an explicit git_save. Preserves or re-injects `// @surf-id`. Do not declare a reserved SurfCAD helper name with const, let, class, or function — the runtime passes these as function parameters: addDraft, align, array3D, booleanBodies, boundaryEdges, cboreHole, center, chamferEdges, clearanceHole, concaveEdges, convexEdges, cskHole, cut, deleteFace, draftFaces, edge, edgesBetween, edgesByOrientation, externalBody, facesByNormal, fastenerClearanceDia, fastenerMajorDia, fastenerTapDrillDia, filletAlongPath, filletEdges, getDimensions, getScaleRatio, hexPrism, hole, holePattern, holeSpan, holesOnContour, hollow, listFastenerSizes, loft, makeCrossSection, makeExtrude, makeLoft, makeRevolve, makeSweepPath, mirror, move, moveFace, offsetPlaneFrame, placeInFrame, placeOnFace, planarFaceAt, polarArray, profileCircle, profilePolygon, profileRectangle, rectTube, resolveFastenerSize, rotateContour, roundedBox, sheetMetalSolid, shell, signedFeatureEdges, solveContour, sumSqDist, sweep, sweepPoints, tapDrillHole, transformByFrame, tube, vecAdd, vecCross, vecDot, vecMul, vecNorm, vecNormalize, vecSub, workplaneFromFace. A redeclaration fails; rename your variable (for example `const cut`).

part_id.description: Part id to write. Must match the active part. Not a vault path.

source.description: Script text written into the editor and run.
